dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: Details on all four targets are up on the board. I can fill you in if needed, but don't bother haggling over the bounties.

choices.text: Submit proof that the bounties have been dealt with.

response.speaker: Leszek
response.text: There are four targets at the moment, but only three of them have leads. The first one's Hidimbi, a fortune teller from Sumeru who's wanted for fraud. You can often find her around <color=#00E1FFFF>the southern docks</color>.

response.speaker: Leszek
response.text: Then there's a rampaging Inazuman Kairagi who's claimed the lives of several traveling merchants passing through the <color=#00E1FFFF>Nothing Passage</color>.

response.speaker: Leszek
response.text: Next up's a gang of smugglers who deal in dangerous goods. They're reportedly hiding out at <color=#00E1FFFF>a camp on the beach north of town</color>.

response.speaker: Leszek
response.text: Finally, there's the vicious pirate known as Hark the Crackjaw. There are no leads on him right now — he's likely gone into hiding.

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: (The notice board lists detailed information on the bounty targets...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (About Hidimbi...)

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "Bounty Target: Hidimbi, a fortune teller from Sumeru. Female, age unknown. Wanted for: Suspected of laying curses and high-value fraud."

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "That woman swindled me out of 18,000,000 Mora! She said that if I wore the necklace she claimed to have acquired from Al-Ahmar, the God of Love, the ladies would fall for me at first sight!"

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "Turns out Al-Ahmar wasn't the God of Love at all. He's been dead for thousands of years, and he never even managed to win over the girl he loved."

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "So the necklace she sold me was real, alright, but it cursed me to never find love. Anyone who can track her down and lift the curse will be handsomely rewarded."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (About the Kairagi...)

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "Bounty Target: Gonpachi, an Inazuman male dressed in Kairagi-style garb. Wanted for: Random assaults on traveling merchants. Multiple casualties reported."

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "The target was last seen near the <color=#00E1FFFF>Nothing Passage</color>. Those who defeat him and provide proof of his death will be handsomely rewarded by the Guild."

dialogues.speaker: Leszek
dialogues.text: Good job. The bounty's yours.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (About Hark the Crackjaw...)

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "Bounty Target: Hark the Crackjaw, former helmsman of the Atlas. Wanted for: Multiple counts of murder. Vicious to the core. Current whereabouts unknown."

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "Anyone who can provide credible intel on his whereabouts will be handsomely rewarded (upon verification of said information)."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (About the smugglers...)

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "Bounty Target: New Iron and Salt Gang. Wanted for: Suspected large-scale smuggling and trafficking of restricted hazardous goods."

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "Investigations indicate that the gang maintains a temporary outpost at <color=#00E1FFFF>a camp on the beach north of town</color>. Those who assist in halting their smuggling operations will be generously rewarded by the Spina di Rosula."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I'll pass for now.)

dialogues.text: (About Hidimbi...)

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "Addendum: This bounty is now reclassified as a search request. Thinking it over, I guess Miss Hidimbi might've had a point. Maybe the necklace didn't work because I wasn't sincere enough in my advances."

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "Whoever can find Miss Hidimbi and bring her back to continue guiding me in this matter will be handsomely rewarded."

dialogues.text: (About the Kairagi...)

dialogues.speaker: Bounty

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
dialogues.text: "Addendum: Bounty fulfilled. According to Mr. Peco's testimony, the target has been neutralized."

dialogues.text: "Addendum: Bounty fulfilled. To the rebranded gentlemen of the Iron and Salt Gang — Spina di Rosula sends its regards."

dialogues.speaker: Bounty
